newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plane crash-lands after hitting kangaroo.
newsitem.headline: Plane crash-lands after hitting kangaroo.

text.p: A small plane carrying four people crash-landed at an airport north of Melbourne on Tuesday when it hit a kangaroo hopping across the runway.
The plane had just touched down on a strip in Bendigo, a rural area north of Melbourne, when a kangaroo bounded in front of the aircraft, local police said.
The plane's landing gear collapsed and it skidded for 180 metres (200 yards) before coming to rest. No-one was injured.
"The kangaroo was killed on impact," police said.
